sections.heading: Buying Advice
body: The best ultralight pack is not always the lightest one. Framing, torso fit, back ventilation, pocket layout, and real load transfer matter just as much as the headline weight.

Choose a more mainstream lightweight pack if comfort and versatility matter most. Choose a premium ultralight specialist pack if aggressive weight reduction is the top priority and you are comfortable with a more niche design.
